name: Fourth
oneLiner: Back-office platform for restaurants and hospitality covering workforce management (HotSchedules scheduling, time and attendance, HR and payroll), inventory and purchasing, and the Fourth iQ AI layer for forecasting and manager recommendations.
bestFor: Multi-unit and enterprise restaurant groups that want labor, inventory and AI forecasting in one back-office suite.

updates.text: Fourth iQ 2.2 added AI recommendations in the iQ manager app to catch inventory shortfalls early, plus workforce recommendations for compliance and less manual admin.
Fourth iQ 2.3 added AI workforce alerts: spikes in early employee exits, which job boards bring the most hires, low schedule-compliance scores, and gaps between the AI and manager sales forecasts.

Appointed Scott Collison, former CEO of Personify and Anaconda, as CEO to lead AI-led product development; Fourth is backed by Marlin Equity Partners. Fourth iQ 3.0, adding above-store AI views for senior leaders, was announced around the same time.

features: AI sales and labor demand forecasting (Fourth iQ)
iQ mobile app with next-best-action recommendations for store managers
Above-store AI views for area and senior leaders (iQ 3.0)
Time and attendance, HR, recruiting and payroll services
Inventory, purchasing and recipe costing with AI inventory alerts

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Fourth does not publish prices.
